_comment: FR-EQ-021 表面电流模型的解析 β 极限 —— 2026-09-18 实测。门：$FYLITE_KERNEL/rust/fylite/src/stability.rs::tests
source: Freidberg, Ideal MHD (Cambridge, 2014), §12.8 surface current model: Eqs. (12.154)–(12.166)

eq_12_164_inverse_q2_coefficients.note: rounded to the printed digits they agree exactly; W13 = 4/(15 q) + 2 M13/q^2 has NO pi^2 term

root.note: the book's 0.21 is (pi/4 q_crit)^2 at its 20-harmonic q_crit = 1.71 (Eq. 12.166), not at the 3-harmonic root

pole.note: D = W11 W33 - W13^2 crosses zero here; W changes sign through a pole. Bisection on (1.0, 1.5) reported it as a root before the D > 0 scan was added

monotone_window: W strictly increasing on q_crit * (1 + 0.01 k), k = -10..10; W(1.2) < 0 < W(3.0)

low_beta.note: c1 > 0 iff q* > 1 (Kruskal-Shafranov); c3 > 0; c2 >= 0 with a double zero at q* = 2 (the book says 'both positive')
